Watch the new Apple Holiday Film about a parents' gift that helps their son rediscover his creativity. Sometimes all it takes to remember what makes us special, is someone who believes in us. A celebration of creativity and the people who inspire it, featuring MacBook Neo.

Directed by Melina Matsoukas

Learn more: https://apple.co/4zioYOK
